name: declared-intervening-edit-example

features.request: Add increment(value), returning value + 1, next to identity() in numbers_demo.py. Preserve identity behavior and add unittest coverage for positive, zero and negative values. Begin by obtaining numbers_demo.py with @standalone read; use the delivered source for your initial edit.

after_read.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path("numbers_demo.py"); p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("return value", "return value + 0"))'

instructions: Use only the standard library. Keep the implementation small.
